findings.evidenceJa: 行き着く所までいくしかなくなる
findings.governingReading: 無闇に襲われたら行き着く所までいくしかなくなる threatens escalation as far as matters can go if attacked.
findings.explanation: Going to the ultimate endpoint is reduced to defending himself.

findings.highlight: I won't activate it as long as I don't get attacked.
findings.governingReading: The final Japanese entry closes with 」 after saying the field will not activate unless he is attacked.
findings.explanation: Shinji’s multi-entry speech has an opening quote but no closing quote.
